title: Band 3 Clerical Officer
description:
Join Our Team at Ulster Hospital Radiology - Admin Office

Are you an organised, people-focused professional with a sparkly personality?

Our Radiology Department at Ulster Hospital is looking for someone just like you to join the team in our Admin Office.

In this role, you'll help keep our imaging services running smoothly by:
- Booking plain film X-ray and ultrasound referrals using our established templates.
- Managing waiting lists efficiently and filling any gaps in the appointment schedule.
- Working closely with patients and clinical staff to ensure a seamless service experience.

Hourly rate - £12.75 per hour
Location - Ulster Hospital Dundonald
Hours - Monday to Friday 9am until 5pm

If you thrive in a busy hospital environment, enjoy working with people, and bring positivity to everything you do, we'd love to hear from you!

Please send cv

title: Financial Services Administrator
description:
Brook Street Recruitment is delighted to be working in partnership with a highly regarded wealth management firm in Belfast City Centre to recruit an experienced Financial Services Administrator.

This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious and detail-oriented individual with a background in financial services administration, IFA support, wealth management, or investment administration to join a respected and growing organisation.

Working closely with Financial Planners and experienced support professionals, you will play a key role in delivering a first-class service to clients while supporting the smooth operation of the business.

The Role

As a Financial Services Administrator, you will be responsible for providing comprehensive administrative support to the wealth management team, ensuring all client-related processes are completed efficiently, accurately, and in accordance with regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities
- Providing day-to-day administrative support to Financial Planners and the wider wealth management team.
- Supporting new business processing and client onboarding activities.
- Preparing, processing, and submitting client applications.
- Maintaining accurate client records across CRM systems and internal databases.
- Processing transactions and instructions relating to investments, ISAs, pensions, and other financial products.
- Liaising effectively with clients, providers, and third-party organisations.
- Tracking and progressing outstanding documentation and applications.
- Preparing documentation and reports for client review meetings.
- Ensuring compliance with internal procedures and FCA regulatory requirements.
- Assisting with process improvement initiatives and learning new systems as required.

About You

To be considered for this opportunity, applicants should have previous experience within a financial services environment, ideally supporting Independent Financial Advisers (IFAs), Wealth Managers, or Financial Planners.

Essential Criteria
- Previous experience in Financial Services Administration, Wealth Management, Investment Administration, or IFA support.
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Strong organisational and time management skills.
- Professional communication skills with a client-focused approach.
- Confident using CRM systems and processing detailed financial information.
- Ability to prioritise workloads and work effectively within a team.
- Positive attitude with a willingness to learn and develop.
- A genuine interest in advancing a career within the wealth management sector.

What's on Offer
- Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Opportunity to join an established and highly respected wealth management firm.
- Exposure to experienced Financial Planners and industry professionals.
- Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.
- Excellent prospects for career progression within financial services.
- Opportunity to develop specialist knowledge across investments, pensions, and private client wealth management.

If you have the relevant financial services administration experience and are looking to take the next step in your career please send your CV to Colleen Farquharson via the apply link

Brook Street NMR is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy.

title: Paralegal - Team 6
description:
To work alongside experienced litigated file handlers and qualified Solicitors to assist with progression of matters,including discovery,analysis of quantum evidence,liaising with counsel and third party experts,trial preparation and legal research.
This role will suit not only experienced paralegals but also graduates seeking to gain vital legal experience with the aim of progressing their legal career including attending ILPS.
To achieve a financial target of 5 chargeable hours per day.

Key Responsibilities
- Work within an insurance defence litigation specialist area, assisting Qualified Solicitors with caseloads in order to pursue completion of files in line with client instruction to the commercial benefit of Keoghs.
- Communicate, build and utilize relationships with colleagues, clients and third parties in a professional and knowledgeable manner; including all methods of communication: in person, over the phone and written
- Progressing discovery matters by drafting the appropriate pleadings and thoroughly reviewing all discoverable material;
- Carrying out legal research, reviewing evolving case law and procedural nuances of certain claims;
- Assisting with investigation matters by taking both informal and formal statements from witnesses;
- Assisting with trial preparation with compiling trial bundles and helping both clients and witnesses prepare to testify at trial;
- Compiling an in-depth analysis of quantum evidence which includes preparing chronologies and identifying anomalies across various sources of evidence to include Hospital and GP notes but also medico-legal reports to assist the lead file handler with reserves calculations;
- Instructing Counsel and medico-legal experts by compiling briefs and letters of instruction;
- Daily task list management including prioritisation and managing deadlines;
- Work to and maintain Service Level Agreements;
- Work well within the team, act as a role model for Keoghs Values.
- To fully utilise the Case Management system for efficient supervision and progression of files, ensuring that all cases are properly managed and tracked, to ensure completeness of records and to ensure accurate reporting of information to our clients.

To adhere to Keoghs' financial hygiene practices through the financial Case Management system, ensuring that all financial aspects relating to cases are handled accurately.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise
- Law Degree
- No previous experience is necessary
- Excellent listening, verbal and written communication
- Ability to prioritise work, keep to deadlines and work under pressure
- Ability to work to agreed targets and service level agreements
- Excellent research skills
- High level of analytical skills
- Excellent IT skills
- Behaviours - displays a positive and professional attitude towards their work and colleagues in line with Keoghs Shared Behaviours
- Communication - ability to adapt communication style to ensure a mutual understanding is achieved both with customers and colleagues
- Planning & Organisation - ability to structure, manage and prioritise workload accordingly
- Adaptability - ability to adapt to different situations and tasks, whilst maintaining quality and service

Job Benefits

title: Trainee Digital Marketing Manager No experience needed (Ref: 6901)
description:
DIGITAL MARKETING TRAINEESHIP (REMOTE)

Become a Digital Marketing Professional and Build Real-World Experience

Are you interested in digital marketing, online business, and helping organisations grow through effective marketing strategies? Do you want to gain practical experience while developing skills that employers are actively looking for?

We are offering a Digital Marketing Traineeship designed to help aspiring digital marketers develop industry-relevant knowledge through structured learning and practical projects.

What You Will Learn

Throughout the traineeship, you will develop an understanding of:
- Digital Marketing Fundamentals
- Marketing Strategy and Planning
- Search Engine Optimisation (SEO)
- Pay-Per-Click (PPC) Advertising
- Social Media Marketing
- Content Marketing
- Email Marketing
- Google Analytics and Marketing Analytics
- Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO)
- Customer Journey Mapping
- Branding and Positioning
- Market Research and Competitor Analysis
- Artificial Intelligence (AI) for Marketing
- Marketing Automation
- Campaign Planning and Performance Measurement
- Marketing Reporting and Data Analysis

Practical Experience

You will work on realistic marketing projects that may include:
- Developing digital marketing strategies
- SEO audits and optimisation recommendations
- Social media campaign planning
- Content creation and marketing calendars
- Email marketing campaigns
- Marketing analytics and reporting
- Website optimisation projects
- Competitor research
- Brand positioning exercises
- Portfolio projects demonstrating your marketing skills

This practical experience will help you develop a professional portfolio that demonstrates your capabilities to future employers.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for individuals who:
- Have an interest in marketing, business, and technology
- Enjoy analysing data and solving problems
- Have good communication skills
- Are creative and eager to learn
- Can work independently and manage their time effectively
- Have basic computer skills

No previous digital marketing experience is required. Successful applicants will undertake our paid Digital Marketing training programme before progressing into employment. The cost of the training is the responsibility of the learner, and full guidance and support will be provided throughout the programme.

Benefits
- Remote and flexible learning
- Industry-relevant curriculum
- Portfolio development opportunities
- Practical project experience
- Mentoring and personalised feedback
- Career guidance and employability support
- Opportunity to develop skills sought by modern employers

Entry Requirements
- A good level of written English
- Access to a computer and internet connection
- Motivation to learn and develop professionally

Career Opportunities

Upon successful completion, learners may pursue roles such as:
- Digital Marketing Executive
- Digital Marketing Specialist
- SEO Executive
- PPC Executive
- Content Marketing Executive
- Social Media Executive
- Email Marketing Executive
- Marketing Coordinator
- Marketing Analyst
- Growth Marketing Executive
- Performance Marketing Executive
- Digital Marketing Assistant

Apply Today

If you are looking to start a career in Digital Marketing and want to gain practical experience while developing a professional portfolio, we would love to hear from you.

Submit your application today and begin your journey towards a career in one of the world's fastest-growing industries.

We advertise this role across multiple UK locations - you only need to apply once and you'll be considered for all of them.
